description: This file is a Go source file containing utility functions for handling JSON responses over HTTP, error handling, and establishing gRPC connections for device control within an Android Cuttlefish frontend project.

methods.name: ReplyError
methods.description: Logs an error message and sends an error message over a JSON connection.

methods.name: ReplyJSONOK
methods.description: Sends a successful JSON response with HTTP status 200.

methods.name: ReplyJSONErr
methods.description: Logs an error and sends an error JSON response based on the error type.

methods.name: ReplyJSON
methods.description: Sends a JSON response with specified HTTP status code.

methods.name: ConnectControlEnvProxyServer
methods.description: Establishes a gRPC connection to the Control Environment Proxy Server for a given device ID within a device pool.
